question: Please find out how widespread the appeal of our top five actors is. What percentage of our customers have rented films featuring these actors?
sql:
-- Final answer: percentage of customers who have rented films featuring any of the top 5 actors
SELECT 
    ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT r.customer_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer) * 100, 2) as percentage
FROM rental r
JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
JOIN film_actor fa ON i.film_id = fa.film_id
WHERE fa.actor_id IN (
    SELECT a.actor_id
    FROM actor a
    JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id
    GROUP BY a.actor_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(fa.film_id) DESC
    LIMIT 5
);
